name: Virginia Beach city, VA
findings: Virginia Beach city has 1,445 nonprofit organizations. 604 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 477 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Virginia Beach city has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 97 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 97 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 4 professional organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through professional groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 13 research and think tank organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
